Title: REINVENT 4 Mol2MolScaffold
Description: Explores analogues that keep the scaffold of a query molecule, merging the output of two REINVENT 4 Mol2Mol priors, one trained on ChEMBL pairs sharing an identical Murcko scaffold and the other on pairs sharing the generic, unlabelled scaffold. Duplicates and the query itself are discarded, leaving up to 100 distinct structures per input. Loeffler and co-workers at AstraZeneca built these transformer priors inside an openly licensed design framework. Decoding is by beam search, so the same input always returns the same set.
Interpretation: Up to 100 distinct analogues of the input molecule, each built on its exact or generic Murcko scaffold.
